message.content: {"caption":"A pale-blue rounded text panel presents a fill-in template for a user–assistant exchange.","description":"A pale-blue rectangular panel with rounded corners and a thin blue outline contains black monospaced text. It explains that a user asks a question and the assistant solves it, first thinking through the reasoning and then providing an answer. Four right-pointing arrow markers introduce continuation lines explaining that the reasoning and answer are enclosed in <think>...</think> and <answer>...</answer> tags, respectively, with an example of those tags. Below, “User:” is followed by the green placeholder {TASK_INSTRUCTION}; “Assistant:” is followed by <think>. The arrows are line markers, not connections between components.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
